items.label: text
items.text: A class of 11 students carried out an experiment to determine how much calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) was in a sample of limestone. Each student was given a different mass of limestone, which they added to 50 cm³ of dilute hydrochloric acid and then measured the volume of carbon dioxide produced using the apparatus shown below.

items.label: list_item
items.text: a Name a piece of apparatus that could be used to measure out 50 cm³ of dilute hydrochloric acid. (1)

items.label: list_item
items.text: b The diagram shows the reading from the experiment carried out by Student 2.

items.label: text
items.text: Complete the table with the volume of gas collected by Student 2. (1)
